messages:
Ari (People Ops): Kicking off a short thread: 'Micro-Celebrations' pilot proposal. Lightweight $25 instant recognitions managers can send from a Slack shortcut. Want pilot owners, a quick approval flow, and tax/budget checks.
Tom (People Ops): Love it. Goal: reduce friction for small wins (on-the-spot thank-yous). Pilot ask: 4 teams, 6 weeks, measure uptake + payment latency.
Nadia (Payroll): FYI <$50 per award we can do prepaid e-gift cards, but we need recipient email and country. Batch runs need 48h lead time.
Owen (Finance): Budget wise let's map to GL RECOG-MICRO-2026. Need a budget_code field in the payload. Also please cap per-person frequency (max 4 micro awards / quarter).
Pri (Eng Manager): I'll volunteer Platform as a pilot team. Quick question: will managers be able to add a short reason? We need a short reason for transparency.
Ari (People Ops): Yes — form will include 140-char reason, public_shoutout boolean, and an internal ops_note.
Sam (Sales Manager): Sales wants the ability to mark awards as "commission neutral" for commissionable activities. Can we add a flag to notify Compensation?
Tom (People Ops): Good catch. We'll add comp_flag boolean and webhook to notify Comp team when set.
Nadia (Payroll): For international recipients, we prefer local vendors. Add recipient_country and payout_preference (local_vendor / usd_gift / payroll).
Owen (Finance): Also add cumulative_awards_90d field so ops can auto-block if a recipient would exceed $600. Finance will audit weekly exports.
Ari (People Ops): Proposed flow: 1) manager triggers Slack shortcut -> fills recipient, amount($25 default), reason, public_shoutout 2) ops queue validates budget and frequency 3) payroll issues prepaid card in next batch 4) shoutout posted if allowed.
Pri (Eng Manager): Will Slack action be single click approve or require manager email confirmation?
Tom (People Ops): Shortcut will record manager ID as approver. For audit we will also capture manager_approver_email via SSO mapping.
Sam (Sales Manager): Can we include a tiny template message that goes to recipients? Like: "Thanks {name} for {reason}. Enjoy this small token!" Makes it less awkward.
Ari (People Ops): Yes will provide template and an edit field.
Nadia (Payroll): A few operational notes: 1) batches on Tue/Thu 2) vendor lead time 48h 3) test vendor TEST-MICRO-01 works for e-gift. Provide a test recipient to validate.
Tom (People Ops): Test recipient: micro.test+1@redwood.ai. Nadia, please confirm delivery to that address.
Nadia (Payroll): Confirmed — will run test this Thu.
Owen (Finance): We'll need a CSV export schema: recipient_name,recipient_email,org,team,amount_usd,budget_code,manager_approver_email,recipient_country,public_shoutout,cumulative_awards_90d,submission_ts. Finance will validate GLs.
Ari (People Ops): Ops will maintain a locked Airtable view with internal_notes and vendor_id fields for payroll-only access. Public exports will omit internal_notes.
Pri (Eng Manager): Pilot metrics: #nominations, approval SLA, payment latency, opt-outs, and any commission flags. Happy to capture.
Tom (People Ops): Training plan: 10-min demo + Loom + 1-pager for managers. Who can run demos? Pri offered Platform; Sam will do Sales session.
Sam (Sales Manager): Yup, I'll take Sales demo Tue 11am PT.
mini-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Micro-Celebrations pilot test run" Thu 9:00 AM PT. :tada:
Ari (People Ops): Timeline proposal: this week build prototype + Slack shortcut, Thu run test with micro.test+1, next Mon start 6-week pilot with Platform, Sales, Ops, and Product.
Owen (Finance): Finance will review the first export after week 1 and report any issues.
Nadia (Payroll): I'll monitor vendor deliveries and confirm timing. If any country issues pop up we'll fallback to payroll.
Tom (People Ops): One compliance note: if recipient opts out of public_shoutout we won't post anything. We'll surface opt-out checkbox prominently.
Ari (People Ops): Great. I'll post the prototype link here when the Slack shortcut is live and share the manager playbook draft. Thanks everyone — will follow up with the prototype link and the CSV schema.
Pri (Eng Manager): Looking forward to trying it with Platform.
Sam (Sales Manager): Ditto for Sales.
Ari (People Ops): Closing note: pilot goal is to make recognition immediate and low-friction while keeping finance & payroll controls. If you have other edge cases (contractors, interns), flag them here.
